ui.tz_milestone_guide: Isaha y'akarere n'ihindura (UTC{tz_str}): Agashushanyo gahindura isaha; guhindura UTC bishobora kwimura umucuruzi ku munsi w'ejo hashize cyangwa w'ejo hazaza.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Imashini y'igihe: Hindura iminsi inyuma cyangwa imbere kugira ngo urebe amakuru yashize cyangwa azaza, ugereranye amateka. Ni ukureba gusa; amakuru ntakorwaho.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN ishingiro: ikunda amakuru nyayo, igenzura itemba ry'icyiciro & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + kunyeganyega kuri k, p; ku byuho 16 / 116 / 132 cyangwa umuzenguruko 1072 ikoresha k*116 + p*16 kuri k, p kugira ngo bihure n'icyiciro, yuzuza icyuho imbere niba kidahari.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Ihitamo risanzwe ry'uburyo bwa 119 (k*119 + kunyeganyega); iyo icyuho ari 16 / 116 / 132 cyangwa cyageze ku muzenguruko 1072 (imiterere y'intambwe 14), ikoresha k*116 + p*16 kuri k, p kugira ngo yimukire mu Cyiciro A gihura (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Ikunze inzira ya 119 (k*119 + kunyeganyega); ku byuho 16 / 116 / 132 cyangwa umuzenguruko 1072 (k*116 + p*16 kuri k, p), ishyigikira icyiciro cyahinduwe A2 / C7 kandi igasubira inyuma iyo amakuru adahari.
